# Cliffe Oluoch Okoth

> Data and Analytics Engineer based in Nairobi, Kenya with 2+ years of experience building batch and streaming data pipelines in Python and SQL. Microsoft Certified in Microsoft Fabric (DP-700) and Azure Databricks (DP-750).

Also known as: Cliffe Okoth, Cliffe Oluoch.
Last updated: 2026-11-25.

Cliffe Oluoch Okoth specializes in Medallion lakehouse architectures (OneLake, Delta Lake, Parquet), log-based Change Data Capture (Debezium, PostgreSQL WAL, Apache Kafka), PySpark Structured Streaming and orchestrated ETL/ELT pipelines (Apache Airflow, dbt, Astronomer Cosmos, Google BigQuery, Snowflake).

## Featured Data Engineering Projects

- [Hybrid Binance Crypto Market Pipeline](https://github.com/Cliffe16/Hybrid-Binance-Crypto-Market-Pipeline): Real-time CDC and micro-batch streaming engine processing 115,000+ market events across 3,700+ Binance trading pairs using PostgreSQL WAL, Debezium CDC, Apache Kafka, PySpark Structured Streaming (30s micro-batch latency, 1m tumbling-window OHLCV), Apache Cassandra, FastAPI, and Grafana.
- [NBA Analytics Pipeline](https://github.com/Cliffe16/NBA-Analytics-Pipeline): Hybrid edge-to-cloud ELT platform modeling 57,800+ NBA player-game and team-game rows across 3 seasons in Google BigQuery (migrated from Snowflake v1). Uses a residential Ubuntu FastAPI edge worker over Tailscale VPN, Azure VM Apache Airflow, dbt with Astronomer Cosmos (SCD Type 2), pytest, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and Grafana—cutting daily API calls by 99% (~550 to 0–5).
- [NBA Live Grafana Dashboard](https://nba-fastapi-vm.tailc63d64.ts.net): Code-provisioned Grafana BI dashboard serving the NBA Analytics Pipeline.
- [Microsoft Fabric Agricultural Commodities Pipeline](https://github.com/Cliffe16/fabric-agri-commodity-engine-pipelines): Reference Medallion lakehouse implementation on Microsoft Fabric OneLake using PySpark, Delta Lake, Dataflow Gen2, quarantine data quality gates, 5-minute tumbling-window price anomaly detection (≥15% swings), and Power BI Direct Lake.

## Professional Experience

- **Data Engineer at SugarCube Africa (Sep 2024 – Present, Nairobi, Kenya)**: Built Bronze/Silver/Gold Medallion layers on OneLake/Delta Lake with PySpark and SQL; eliminated 10+ hours/week of manual auditing via automated PySpark data quality and quarantine rules; built incremental Apache Airflow DAGs with Celery/Redis caching that cut API payload sizes by 97% (~200KB to 5KB); accelerated transaction clearance by 20% via SQL CTEs and window functions; implemented 5-minute tumbling-window anomaly detection for ≥15% price swings.
- **Data Analyst Intern at Flamingo Commodities (Jan 2024 – Aug 2024, Nairobi, Kenya)**: Eliminated duplicate market records using PostgreSQL MERGE scripts and saved 2+ hours of manual work via Python and Bash file-watcher ingestion scripts.
